mechanism: Open with one oversized total that calibrates scale, unfold into itemized records that prove the claim, refold those records into an aggregate result, pivot through one intermediate milestone to a current-state value, then use one restrained manual annotation to lock the conclusion.

invariants.rule: Open with one dominant total and a compact label before showing its evidence.
invariants.purpose: Creates immediate scale and a clear question about how the total was earned.
invariants.ablation_failure: Starting with many small records removes the hook and hierarchy.

invariants.rule: Unfold the claim into at least two itemized records with visible category separation.
invariants.purpose: Turns a large headline into checkable evidence.
invariants.ablation_failure: A second big number without records feels like another unsupported claim.

invariants.rule: Compress the detailed records into one aggregate result before changing metric family.
invariants.purpose: Rewards the detail pass with a simplified summary state.
invariants.ablation_failure: Jumping directly from records to the final value leaves the proof unresolved.

invariants.rule: Use one physically legible panel or carrier change to reveal an intermediate milestone from a different but related metric family.
invariants.purpose: Makes the information pivot feel causal rather than arbitrary.
invariants.ablation_failure: A plain cut between unrelated metrics obscures their relationship.

invariants.rule: End on the current-state value and add only one restrained annotation after the value is readable.
invariants.purpose: Separates the conclusion from the evidence and gives it a memorable hold.
invariants.ablation_failure: Many marks compete with the value; annotating before readability hides the conclusion.

slots.name: headline_total
slots.constraint: One original, truthful or explicitly fictional dominant total with a short label.

slots.name: record_set
slots.constraint: At least two distinct records whose categories visibly support the headline.

slots.name: aggregate_result
slots.constraint: One summary value derived from the record set.

slots.name: milestone_metric
slots.constraint: One related intermediate milestone shown through a physical carrier change.

slots.name: current_state
slots.constraint: One final current value, not a duplicate of the opening total.

slots.name: material_system
slots.constraint: An original medium whose folds, slides, hinges or layer changes explain information transitions.

slots.name: annotation
slots.constraint: One brief non-brand manual mark added only after the final value is readable.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: Original tactile cues tied to each information-state change.

anti_copy_exclusions: source café photographs and crossed red strips
source black-white-red paper system and final red brush oval

instantiations.concept: A navy-and-cream river-restoration board opens on '24 RESTORED SEGMENTS', unfolds into two transparent field-record cards, compresses to '127K L SAVED', pivots through a baseline efficiency panel and ends on 'CURRENT 92%' with one copper grease-pencil check.
instantiations.prompt_seed: Tactile river-restoration data story: oversized total, two field-record proofs, one aggregate saving, one hinged milestone and a current-state value with a single manual check.

instantiations.concept: A translucent museum-conservation light table starts with '80 OBJECTS STABILIZED', fans out humidity and UV exposure records on acetate, stacks them into one reduced-risk index, flips a frosted milestone pane and ends on the current safe-storage rate sealed with one wax thumbprint.
instantiations.prompt_seed: Museum conservation evidence hierarchy on acetate and frosted glass, progressing from total to records to aggregate to milestone to current state, ending with one wax mark.

failure_modes.failure: The opening contains several equal-sized figures.
failure_modes.repair: Choose one dominant total and one compact label.

failure_modes.failure: The detail state is decorative rather than evidentiary.
failure_modes.repair: Give each record a distinct category and a visible relation to the headline.

failure_modes.failure: The sequence skips the aggregate summary.
failure_modes.repair: Compress records into one result before switching metric family.

failure_modes.failure: The milestone arrives through an arbitrary cut.
failure_modes.repair: Use one hinge, fold, slide or layer change to carry the pivot.

failure_modes.failure: The final annotation obscures or repeats the value.
failure_modes.repair: Wait until the current value is readable, then add one restrained mark.
